mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in months where PAYEMS exceeds 200.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong underlying demand for goods and services, which increases corporate revenue visibility and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1150.0 and RSAFS > 470000.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 100.0 (2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling weakening economic momentum and reduced corporate profitability, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal generates positive returns in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based demand surge, which increases corporate revenue expectations and drives equity market gains over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 470000.0 and HOUST > 1150.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS and HOUST exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal fails to outperform individual proxies in a regression framework.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 1.5% per annum signals a tightening monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5% (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal produces positive returns in more than 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 4.4% and a rise in non-farm payroll growth above 150k signals a tight labor market with strong hiring momentum, increasing wage pressures and corporate input costs, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.4 and PAYEMS > 146500.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE < 4.4 and PAYEMS > 146500.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 470,000 million dollars, combined with a rise in GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized, indicates strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 470000.0 and GDPC1 > 2.0 in the prior quarter
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS and GDPC1 exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term in a predictive regression is not significant (p > 0.05).
